ol.li: Log in to the SMS mobile application.

li.p: Tap Alerts on the bottom menu.
The alerts list is displayed. Each alert lists the motor name / component name and the status of the component. This is followed by the plant / process name, any fault detected, and action required.
Tap the alert whose health plot you want to view.
The corresponding health plot of the component is displayed. The blue dots represent the fault index for a given sample on a given component.

ol.li: Stretch an area of the plot (using two fingers) to zoom in on a specific date or time period. To zoom out, tap Reset zoom.
Tap a blue dot to view the exact health index and the date and time that the data was acquired.
